IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S2: one reporting-gold writer cannot serve three firms; cottonwood and inflection have no declared custody source and no function, so their demand is recorded null.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S3: 23 returns-only backfill invocations over 2024-07-08..2026-10-01 ran on 2026-10-03 and logged no activity line; the activity table's history starts 2026-10-07.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S4: an explicit backfill rewrites the returns days of its range, so Branch A cannot keep the returns tables untouched; the check must read key count and dates.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S5: the lots stage logged LOTS_SKIPPED for 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08 on the realized-lot key check, and a backfill logs such a refusal without raising.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S6: the 25-day chunk bound has never run with the lots stage; at the measured one-day rate a chunk would pass the 900-second function timeout.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S7: a re-run of 2026-10-08 computed 6904 activity rows against 6901 landed, so the order's idempotence premise does not hold.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S8: the 565-day trading-day count rests on the calendar's hardcoded NYSE fallback, because pandas_market_calendars is absent.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W369-S9: events list-rules returns no reporting-gold rule; the schedule is an EventBridge Scheduler schedule, which the order's named read does not cover.
